comments.title: A non-numeric parameter is a 400 on every endpoint, not just the list
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.65 — A non-numeric parameter is a 400 on every endpoint, not just the list

**Not taken:** parse page/size as strings locally; `/api/owners/abc` stays a 500

**Why:** a global handler is Spring's own default and the least code, but it changes untouched endpoints' status for malformed path ids, which nobody asked for.

comments.title: On a failed request, rows are cleared and the table hidden
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.55 — On a failed request, rows are cleared and the table hidden

**Not taken:** keep the last good page visible beneath the error

**Why:** stale rows under an error read as current data; but losing the paginator is what the correctness reviewer tripped on, so this is close to a coin flip.

comments.title: Add Owner is shown in every state, including loading and error
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.80 — Add Owner is shown in every state, including loading and error

**Not taken:** show it only after the first successful load, as before

**Why:** the design asks for Add Owner access across loading, empty and error layouts; the old gating looked accidental rather than intended.

comments.title: An empty sort= or size= falls back to the default instead of a 400
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.60 — An empty sort= or size= falls back to the default instead of a 400

**Not taken:** reject an empty value as malformed

**Why:** Spring applies `defaultValue` to empty strings and the spec only lists omitted parameters; nothing pins what an empty value should do.

comments.title: Sort tokens are exact lowercase; name,ASC is rejected
comments.anchor: throw new ValidationException("sort must be one of name,asc name,desc city,asc city,desc");
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.70 — Sort tokens are exact lowercase; name,ASC is rejected

**Not taken:** accept the direction case-insensitively

**Why:** the spec lists four exact tokens as the whitelist; a lenient parser would widen the contract nobody asked to widen.

comments.title: "Unrepresentable page" means page times size overflows the offset
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.80 — "Unrepresentable page" means page times size overflows the offset

**Not taken:** only reject a page number that overflows an int

**Why:** Spring Data throws a 500 when the offset exceeds an int, so that is the bound a valid request cannot cross; the int-parse overflow is caught separately.

comments.title: Page size documented as a 5–20 range, not an enum
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.70 — Page size documented as a 5–20 range, not an enum

**Not taken:** an enum of "5","10","20", typed as strings by springdoc

**Why:** springdoc renders allowableValues as strings on an integer, a schema lie; the exact set lives in the description instead.

comments.title: The service omits absent parameters; the component always sends all four
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.85 — The service omits absent parameters; the component always sends all four

**Not taken:** the service fills in the defaults itself

**Why:** the API owns its defaults; duplicating them in the client is a second place to drift.

comments.title: Graph fetch without SQL DISTINCT
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.90 — Graph fetch without SQL DISTINCT

**Not taken:** keep `SELECT DISTINCT` as JPQL habit

**Why:** Hibernate 6 dedupes fetch-joined roots in memory; DISTINCT only added a sort over every joined column, and the nested-data tests stay green without it.

comments.title: Pets cell rendered as divs, not nested table rows
comments.body:
💭 **Assumption** · confidence 0.85 — Pets cell rendered as divs, not nested table rows

**Not taken:** keep the invalid `<tr>` inside a `<td>`

**Why:** a `<tr>` in a `<td>` is invalid HTML the browser re-parents; no test or e2e selector depended on it.
